effect_evidence.note: Frozen independent effect evidence for the ARB `successful_full_loop` dimension. The prediction is bound to the ActionType the replay builds; the authoritative observation comes from a source that never receives the executor receipt, so closure cannot be satisfied by dispatch success. The negative cases are the fail-closed evidence classes: missing, stale, incomplete, conflicting, and not-yet-recorded.

negative_cases.note: No authoritative observation was produced before closure was attempted.
The only observation arrived after the prediction's observation deadline.
The observation does not cover the predicted metric, so the evidence set is incomplete.
The authoritative observation contradicts the prediction it is correlated to.

The observation carries a value the prediction accepts and a time inside the effect window, but a time later than the moment the comparison is recorded on the replay timeline, so it has not happened yet from the recorder's point of view and cannot be scored.

note: ARB observability precondition: a fleet VM with no managed identity has no attestable workload identity, so the change-safety objective is unmeasurable until the identity is assigned. Props fire ONLY managed-identity.assigned; a present environment tag and healthy utilisation satisfy the co-resident compute.vm rules so the citing set stays single-rule.
